title: Noisy sources
description: Which log sources keep raising anomalies, and how much of that the closed triage items call noise. Times are UTC.

facts.noCollection: No evaluation has been recorded yet.
facts.summary: {total, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} raised at least one anomaly in the last {days} days. Ordered by {order}.

partial.title: Partial coverage.
partial.text: Nothing is known about the rest, so these numbers are lower bounds, not totals.

table.label: Noisy sources
table.caption: Log sources ranked by anomalies raised, with alerts, the share closed as noise and the worst deviation
table.notMonitoredHint: This source is not monitored, so no counts are collected.
table.notJudgedHint: A low count here is not evidence of calm.

footnote: Noise and worst deviation always cover the last 28 days of stored data, whichever window is selected. Incidents and alerts follow the selected window.

quiet.summary: No incidents on {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}}
quiet.judged: {count, plural, one {# source is} other {# sources are}} judged and raised nothing in {days} days.
quiet.notJudged: {count, plural, one {# source is} other {# sources are}} not judged: no reliable baseline for this weekday and hour. A quiet count there is not evidence of calm.
quiet.none: Every monitored source raised at least one anomaly in the last {days} days.

empty.title: No source raised an anomaly
empty.fallback: No source raised an anomaly in the last {days} days of stored data.
empty.withCollection: The last evaluation was <time></time>, so the collection is running and the window is quiet.
empty.noCollection: No evaluation has been recorded, so this may be a missing collection and not a quiet window.

pastEnd.title: This page is past the end of the list
pastEnd.text: {total, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} raised anomalies; the list starts at row {offset}.

errors.title: The noisy-sources list could not be loaded
errors.failed: The counts are unknown, not zero. Reload the page; if it fails again, check that the API is reachable and ask an administrator.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view noisy sources. Ask an administrator for the read:anomalies grant.
errors.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to see the list.

detail.descriptionFallback: Per-detector counts and a replay of the stored buckets under the values you choose. Times are UTC.
detail.countsCaption: Incidents and alerts per detector for 7 and 28 days, with the share closed as noise and the worst deviation
detail.noDetectors: No detector has raised an incident for this source in the stored 28 days.
detail.countsFootnote: Noise and worst deviation always cover the last 28 days of stored data.
detail.notMonitoredNotice: This source is not monitored, so no counts are collected and a replay has nothing to read. Enable monitoring on the log source first.
detail.notJudgedHint: A low count here is not evidence of calm.
detail.partialText: The counts cover {covered} of {window} days and are lower bounds, not totals.

errors.title: The tuning page could not be loaded
errors.failed: The counts and the current values are unknown. Reload the page; if it fails again, check that the API is reachable and ask an administrator.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this page. Ask an administrator for the read:anomalies grant.
errors.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to tune this source.
errors.notFound: This log source does not exist or was removed. Go back to the list and pick another.

tuning.title: Replay and tune
tuning.intro: Choose new values, replay the stored buckets under them and compare with the values in force. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

deviation_z.label: Deviation
deviation_z.hint: Standard deviations from the expected count before a bucket deviates.

spike_ratio.label: Spike ratio
spike_ratio.hint: A bucket above this multiple of the expected count is a spike.

drop_ratio.label: Drop ratio
drop_ratio.hint: A bucket below this fraction of the expected count is a drop.

min_absolute_delta_events.label: Minimum change
min_absolute_delta_events.hint: Smaller absolute changes are ignored, however large the ratio.

open_after.label: Open after
open_after.hint: Consecutive deviating buckets before an incident opens.

problem.range: The value must be from {min} to {max}.
problem.whole: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.

origin.unreadable: stored value {value} is not usable; the engine ignores it

tuning.criticalityHint: Sets how many buckets must deviate before an incident opens, unless open after is set above.
tuning.labMode: In LAB_MODE criticality changes no detection threshold.
tuning.byType: This source has per-type overrides. Their detector thresholds are inert here; only open and resolve timing can differ by type.
tuning.narrowing: Saving this direction closes this source's open incidents of the disabled direction.
tuning.saveNeedsPreview: Run a preview for these values to enable Save.
tuning.saveNothing: Nothing differs from the saved values.
tuning.saveFirstPreviewed: Save applies exactly the values the preview used.
tuning.needWrite: You can preview but not save: saving needs the log_source:write permission. Ask an administrator for it.
tuning.needWriteUnread: Your permissions could not be read, so Save stays off. Reload the page.
tuning.previewFailed: The replay could not run, and nothing was changed. {detail}
tuning.previewForbidden: The replay needs the read:anomalies permission.
tuning.saveFailed: The values were not saved and nothing was changed.
tuning.saveForbidden: Saving needs the log_source:write permission. Nothing was changed.
tuning.saveExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again; nothing was changed.
tuning.rejected: The server rejected the values: {detail} Nothing was changed.

saved.title: Saved.
saved.recorded: The audit log keeps the preview you saw.
saved.closed: Open incidents of the disabled direction were closed.
saved.reloadFailed: The page could not re-read the source, so the values above are the ones you saved. Reload to see how the engine now resolves them.

tuning.rejectedField: The server rejected a value; its message is next to the field. Nothing was changed.

result.title: Replay result
result.coverage: Replay of {days} days of stored buckets, from <first></first> to <last></last>; {covered} of {days} days are stored.
result.coverageNone: Replay of {days} days; no stored bucket falls inside it.
result.partialText: The counts cover only {covered} of {days} days, so they are lower bounds for the window.
result.criticalityLab: LAB_MODE: criticality changes no detection threshold, so the counts do not depend on the criticality change.
result.explain: M and N count the incidents a replay would open from a clean start, using the stored buckets and today's baseline. They are not a forecast, and they are not what was recorded.
result.tableCaption: Incidents the replay would open under the current and the proposed values
result.recorded: Recorded in the same window: {incidents, plural, one {# incident} other {# incidents}}, {opened} opened, {suppressed} suppressed. This is the recorded history, not a replay count.
result.unjudged: {count, plural, one {# bucket was} other {# buckets were}} not judged and {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} left out of M and N.
result.maintenanceBuckets: {count, plural, one {# bucket was} other {# buckets were}} recorded under a maintenance window, which the replay cannot reconstruct.
result.notReplayableNote: These detectors are left out of M and N.
result.stale: Values changed. Preview again before saving; the numbers below belong to the earlier values.

insufficient.title: No replay for this window
insufficient.text: No count is shown, because a count here would be a guess.
insufficient.fallback: The stored buckets cannot support a replay.

tooLarge.title: This window is too large to replay
tooLarge.text: No count is shown. A shorter window reads fewer buckets.

result.partialNote: They describe that span only, not the whole window.

model.title: Low-volume model
model.shadow: A shadow view. No detector uses it and it opens no alert. It shows what a count model would see in the stored baseline cells.
model.loading: Reading the stored baseline cells and replaying the window.
model.noReason: The model has no sentence for this state.

facts.pValue: p = {p}: a bucket counts when its count is at least this unlikely under the fitted model
facts.kValue: A thin cell's median is pulled toward the source's pooled median with k = {k}; the weight on the cell is n / (n + {k})

model.partialText: {covered} of {window} days are stored. Tail counts use only the buckets that exist; a missing bucket is a gap, not a zero.

disabled.title: The low-volume model preview is switched off
disabled.text: The setting LOW_VOLUME_MODEL_PREVIEW_ENABLED is false on this deployment, so this view is not computed. Nothing else on this page depends on it.

unknown.title: The model could not be read
unknown.text: The server does not know this log source. Go back to the noisy sources and open it again.

forbidden.title: The model needs permission
forbidden.text: Reading the low-volume model requires the read:anomalies permission.

expired.title: The session has expired
expired.text: Sign in again to read the low-volume model.

failed.title: The model could not be loaded
failed.text: The count-model view is unknown, not empty. Retry; if it fails again, the backend log names the cause.

shifts.title: {count, plural, one {# cell proposes a new normal} other {# cells propose a new normal}}
shifts.intro: Proposals only. Nothing is written back to a baseline.
shifts.none: No cell proposes a new normal: no last-7-day median left its own 5th to 95th percentile range with at least 8 samples on both sides.

grid.caption: {metric}: stored baseline cell for each weekday and UTC hour. The number in a cell is how many buckets of the last 28 days fell below p on either tail.
grid.weekdayHead: Weekday, with the hour in UTC
grid.unitLine: Each cell: buckets in the last 28 days below p, by weekday and UTC hour. The metric itself is measured in {unit}.
grid.empty: The response holds no cells for this metric.

detail.title: Selected cell
detail.none: Select a cell to read its numbers.
detail.heading: {metric}, {weekday} {hour} UTC
detail.estimateWeight: weight {weight} on this cell, n = {n}, k = {k}, pooled median {pooled}
detail.shiftText: The last 7 days' median is {recent}; the stored cell median is {cell} (5th to 95th percentile {p05} to {p95}). Recent samples {recentSamples}, stored samples {cellSamples}. Started at the bucket of

calibration.title: Calibration against closed noise
calibration.intro: Of the buckets the current detectors flagged when the last 28 days were replayed, how many fall on incidents operators already closed as NOISE. This is evidence for a later model, not a verdict.
calibration.caption: Replayed flags per detector and how many fell on incidents closed as noise
calibration.excluded: Not run: the source's direction setting excludes this detector.
calibration.none: The response holds no calibration rows.
